vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who lives in the same apartment or room as you
vocabulary.example: My roommate and I share the kitchen.

vocabulary.meaning_en: time away from work or school to rest or travel
vocabulary.example: We are on vacation next week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long trip by car
vocabulary.example: We went on a road trip across the country.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to put things in a bag for a trip
vocabulary.example: Did you pack your bags?

vocabulary.meaning_en: things written one after another
vocabulary.example: I made a list of things to buy.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a famous statue in New York harbor
vocabulary.example: We took a boat to the Statue of Liberty.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a mountain in South Dakota with the faces of four U.S. presidents
vocabulary.example: Mount Rushmore has four huge faces.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a very large, deep valley in Arizona
vocabulary.example: The Grand Canyon is very deep.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a forest of very tall red trees in California
vocabulary.example: Redwood trees can be very old.

vocabulary.meaning_en: not interested because nothing exciting is happening
vocabulary.note_ar: bored = الشخص يشعر بالملل. boring = الشيء ممل.
vocabulary.note_en: bored = how you feel; boring = the thing that makes you feel that way.
vocabulary.example: I'm bored. Let's play a game.

vocabulary.meaning_en: known by many people
vocabulary.example: New York is a famous American city.

vocabulary.meaning_en: land with water all around it
vocabulary.example: We took a boat to the island.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to get to a place
vocabulary.note_ar: arrive in + مدينة/دولة، arrive at + مكان محدد.
vocabulary.note_en: arrive in a city/country; arrive at a place.
vocabulary.example: We will arrive at noon.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a chair that moves forward and back
vocabulary.example: Grandpa sits in his rocking chair.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the area next to a road
vocabulary.example: We bought fruit at a roadside shop.

vocabulary.meaning_en: interesting places that tourists visit
vocabulary.example: We saw all the sights in Rome.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to leave trash on the ground in a public place
vocabulary.example: Please don't litter in the park.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who listens
vocabulary.example: My mom is a good listener.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to go into a place
vocabulary.example: We are entering the city now.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the way something is going: north, south, east, west
vocabulary.example: We are going in the wrong direction.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to leave; a way out
vocabulary.example: Take the next exit off the highway.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a big, fast road between cities
vocabulary.example: Cars drive fast on the highway.

vocabulary.meaning_en: fuel for a car
vocabulary.example: We need to stop for gas.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the leader of a country like the U.S.
vocabulary.example: George Washington was the first U.S. president.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to succeed in getting to a place
vocabulary.example: We made it to the station on time!

vocabulary.meaning_en: having a lot to do
vocabulary.example: We'll be very busy tomorrow.

fine_lines.title: bored vs boring
fine_lines.explanation_ar: bored تصف شعور الشخص (أنا أشعر بالملل). boring تصف الشيء الذي يسبب الملل.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Bored describes how a person feels. Boring describes the thing that causes that feeling.

fine_lines.title: will + verb vs will be + verb-ing
fine_lines.explanation_ar: will stop = قرار أو حدث في المستقبل. will be stopping = حدث سيكون مستمراً في وقت محدد في المستقبل، أو خطة عادية مرتبة.
fine_lines.explanation_en: Will stop = a future action or decision. Will be stopping = an action in progress at a time in the future, or a normal planned event.

examples.sentence: We will be stopping for gas in about an hour.

expressions.phrase: We are going on a road trip together!
expressions.meaning_en: We are going to travel by car together.
expressions.example: This summer, my family is going on a road trip.

expressions.phrase: I packed my bags and I am ready to go!
expressions.meaning_en: Everything is ready for the trip.
expressions.example: The taxi is here. I packed my bags and I'm ready to go!

expressions.meaning_en: Remember to do or include something.

expressions.example: Bored? No way! This trip is fun.
Lunch is in an hour. Can you wait?

expressions.meaning_en: I am very excited about something.
expressions.example: I can't wait to see my grandparents.

expressions.meaning_en: Used before you share surprising news.
expressions.example: Guess what? We're going to the beach!
The bus will be here any minute now.
We finished the project. We did it!

grammar.title: Future continuous: will be + verb-ing
grammar.explanation_ar: نستخدم المستقبل المستمر لحدث سيكون مستمراً في وقت معين في المستقبل، أو لحدث مخطط له في المستقبل. التكوين: will be + الفعل مع ing لكل الضمائر. الاختصار: we'll be, I'll be.
grammar.explanation_en: Use the future continuous for an action that will be in progress at a time in the future, or for a planned future event. Form: will be + verb-ing, for every subject. Short form: we'll be, I'll be.
examples: We will be driving for a long time.
We'll be eating lunch in about 2 hours.
We will be arriving in New York City very soon!
We will be entering North Dakota any minute now!

grammar.title: Negatives and questions: won't be + -ing / Will ... be + -ing?
grammar.explanation_ar: النفي: won't be (will not be) + ing. السؤال: نضع will قبل الفاعل: Will we be stopping soon?
grammar.explanation_en: Negative: won't be (will not be) + verb-ing. Question: put will before the subject: Will we be stopping soon?
examples: No, we won't be seeing that.

questions.question: Make a question: "____ we be stopping soon?"
questions.explanation_ar: السؤال يبدأ بـ will: Will we be stopping?
questions.explanation_en: The question starts with will: Will we be stopping?
